title: Lidskii theorem for directional derivatives of symplectic eigenvalues
summary: In this paper, we present a refinement of the symplectic Lidskii theorem for directional derivatives of symplectic eigenvalues, which is inspired by the work of Sendov [Electron. J. Linear Algebra 41(2025), 338-341]. We show that for a $2n \times 2n$ real positive definite matrix $A$ and symmetric matrices $H, K$ \begin{align*} d'(A;H+K)-d'(A;H) \prec_{π_A} d'(A;K). \end{align*} Here $\prec_{π_A}$ represents block-majorization corresponding to the partition $π_A$ of $\{1,\ldots, n\}$ given by the equality blocks of symplectic eigenvalues of $A$.
